reviews.Author: AWK
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 17, 2026
reviews.Text: Been using this for years, but just found out a third-party testing lab found Redmond Real Seat Salt to be high in lead. See the website called Lead Safe Mama which has paid to have dozens of brands of salt (as well as many other products) third-party tested. As it turns out, it is apparently very hard to keep heavy metals out of salt that is mined from the ground. Go to the Lead Safe Mama website and look up their salt testing results. As a result of their findings I have decided to just use Kirkland (Costco) brand Sea Salt, which did not get into the best category, but was satisfactory, and much less lead than Redmond, as well as much more affordable.

reviews.Author: joseph
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on June 3, 2026

Remember, if you eat unrefined salt, you will always have the surrounding natural elements in the salt bed it’s mined from, the good and the bad.

reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on April 1, 2026
reviews.Text: This salt has grit in it that makes it seem like there is occasional sand in your food. It took me awhile to decipher where the grit was coming from, but it was in every meal I made. Regardless of the fact that the minerals are supposed to be healthy for you, I prefer to not eat food that has dirt or sand in it. I threw it out and got regular salt. reviews.Author: SweetSweet
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on November 20, 2025
reviews.Text: Add another dislike to the list for all the crunchy sand that's in this salt. This salt is mined, so they capture a lot of stone matrix along with the salt, and since it's unrefined, that ground up stone makes it into the final product. If you put this on your food, you will crunch on sand particles with your teeth. It's very unpleasant. Imagine going to a restaurant and having your food have crunchy sand on it. You would send the food back to the kitchen and say, "I don't believe I have to ask the chef to keep the sand out of my food". Redmond should state their salt might have sand in it. They don't mention that anywhere. I'm getting rid of this in an electrolyte drink so I at least drink the sand and not chew on it.
reviews.Title: Too much sand in the salt

reviews.Author: Jackie C
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on December 1, 2025
reviews.Text: Bought this Redmond Sea Salt based on reviews and claims by the manufacturer. Put some of the salt in warm water to gargle with, and noticed a portion on the bottom of my glass did not dissolve. Made a french silk pie, and tasted crunchies in it. Finally left a teaspoon of the salt in a glass of water overnight and was disturbed to see much sediment on the bottom of the glass, a brownish-red color. Poured it onto a paper towel, and tasted it. It was not salty, but tasted like rock or dirt. Have attached a photo. Then was equally disturbed to read that Lead Safe Mama and Mamavation tested it and results showed Lead between 250 and 290 ppb. It's in the trash now. Money wasted.

reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on July 4, 2025
reviews.Text: Why did you pick this product vs others?: The mere look of this salt gave me pause when it arrived. Pure salt is a clear/white color (obviously). So, when I got this and a lot of it was dark yellow to dark brown in color, I got suspicious and started looking into it. This company is hiding behind the term “unrefined”. Let me translate that for you: it’s not filtered and there’s dirt and sand in this “salt”. Stay away. Gross and also a rip off. You can go elsewhere and get actual pure sea salt for consumption that’s pure - white clear in color through and through. Trust your eyes and your common sense. Shame on this shady company who’s making hand over fist on every bag they sell of a product they’re clearly cutting corners on to save on cost and hiding that fact behind the “raw organic” movement. Yall suck.

reviews.Title: If you like eating sand, you'll love it!

reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on July 30, 2024
reviews.Text: I stopped taking this salt because of the article I found by Lead Safe Mama that highlights significant concerns about Redmond Real Salt Ancient Sea Salt, which was found to contain high levels of lead and arsenic, both unsafe for children and adults. The salt contains: Lead: 0.265 ppm Arsenic: 0.05 ppm These levels are well above the "Action Levels" proposed by the scientific and medical communities for the Baby Food Safety Act of 2021. The article criticizes the company for misleading claims about the safety and purity of their product, highlighting the potential health risks of chronic low-level exposure to lead, such as increased risk of heart disease, infertility, kidney failure, and memory impairments. From now on, I avoid mined salts and opt for non-mined sea salts that are confirmed to be low in toxicants based on independent, third-party testing.
reviews.Title: Lead: 0.265 ppm, Arsenic: 0.05 ppm according to Lead Safe Mama's Simple Lab report for heavy metals

reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on May 26, 2022
reviews.Text: Well, I gave this a fair try. But after a couple of weeks, well, "that's enough, thank you very much." There were three ways the Redmond Real Salt didn't appeal to me much at all: 1. And when I started getting what felt like "pieces of dirt" stuck in my teeth, well, that was the end of it for me. Allegedly this is "better" for you in some way than "traditional" salt, but I would recommend "trying life without table salt" over switching to this stuff. If you want to try this, I would recommend trying the smallest, least expensive package you can get, so you won't wind up throwing as much of it away as I did.

reviews.Text: I ordered this to use it for gargling, but when I put it in the water, you can see all the sand on the bottom of the bottle. This is not clean salt.
reviews.Title: Not a clean product

reviews.Author: PeanutBQ
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on June 18, 2024
reviews.Text: This stuff is garbage. It is full of fine sand or grit. I dissolved it in warm water and was left with fine grit in the bottom of a super fine sieve. Since it's considered food, I can't return it. I know it says natural unrefined... didn't think that would mean full of grit! Wish I could give zero stars
reviews.Title: Full of sand or grit of some sort

reviews.Author: Natalie
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 30, 2025
reviews.Text: I made the mistake of not looking at the ingredient listing because I fell for their slogan. Now come to realize there’s sodium added to the salt and for those of you that don’t know sodium is not salt. It’s actually a byproduct of a mold so I do not recommend this product for anybody.
reviews.Title: Not pure salt

reviews.Author: sara deszsell
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 18, 2026
reviews.Text: The description said no need to put rice in your Shaker, that salt will not clump. Or have moisture. I can not shake it out of my Shaker. Its slumped and moist.

reviews.Author: natalya kadoshnikov
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on May 31, 2025
reviews.Text: After using this salt for 2 years, I got bloodwork done and turns out I have hypothyroidism because this salt contains no iodine. Back to the cheap stuff. Your hair will become thin, weak, brittle, break off, grow extremely slow and you’ll have no energy unless you supplement with iodine. It’s overpriced and not good for hormone health.
reviews.Title: Your hair will become thin, brittle, and fall out

reviews.Author: Amazon Customer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 26, 2025
reviews.Text: I heard a lot of people talking about this salt, so I bought it, I am not impressed at all, the salt tastes just like any other pink Himalayan salt i can buy for 1/10 the price at any grocery store. I was buying a mineral sea salt, and that tasts way better than this stuff. Very disappointed and will not repurchase
reviews.Title: Nothing special

reviews.Author: Am
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on May 25, 2026
reviews.Text: Notice the size of this salt bag! Be aware it is NOT the usual size you buy.
reviews.Title: Watch out for small sizes!

reviews.Author: C
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on May 3, 2019
reviews.Text: I'm kind of grossed out. It seems like I got a fake product, like it's just pink sand. The "salt" is super gritty and WILL NOT dissolve all the way, even in boiling water, or when used on chicken in a pressure cooker, leaving the food gritty, as if there is sand in the food. I've tried boiling it, i've used in it the pressure cooker, i've even baked it and it's always gritty on the food!!! EW! Nothing like taking a bite of sandy/gritty food :(
reviews.Title: Literally won't even dissolve in boiling water-still crunchy!!

reviews.Author: Thaddeus
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on August 2, 2023
reviews.Text: My first taste was greeted with mineral crunchiness, quite a bit of it, so I went online to look it up. Apparently Redmond’s thinks it’s totally fine that there’s sand in there product. They say it’s part of the mineral content. Uh huh, except normally when we talk about mineral content it’s referencing minerals you can uptake. You can’t uptake sand.
reviews.Title: Who is good with eating sand?

reviews.Author: HomeHackHero
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on April 27, 2025
reviews.Text: As a previous user stated, it Has rocks mixed in with salt. You can taste them and feel them in everything you put this on. So unless you like your food to taste like someone sprinkled a little sand on it, I would not recommend this.
reviews.Title: Very gritty salt

reviews.Author: good book lover
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on October 3, 2025
reviews.Text: I had heard good things about this salt, and I do appreciate that it is mined in the United States. However, I used this salt to make bread, and it was like eating bread with sand in it. Who wants sand in their bread?
reviews.Title: Like eating sand

reviews.Author: Shyla
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 28, 2026
reviews.Text: This salt is full of sand. It ruined 3 loaves of sour dough bread. If you like sand in your food this salt is for you!
reviews.Title: Sand in this salt!

reviews.Author: Mary D.
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on June 27, 2025
reviews.Text: I wasn't sure where the grit taste was coming from ..now I know its in this salt! there is sand/dirt mixed in with this salt..we have experienced this crunch in several foods after using this salt.! they need to go back to the drawing table on this one..going in the trash today!
reviews.Title: sand/dirt in this product..

reviews.Author: Riley-Rau
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on July 29, 2024
reviews.Text: The salt itself does taste delicious. However The sheer amount of Rock grit in the salt is unacceptable. No one wants to be chewing rocks. In the photo there is 1 tsp of salt dissolved in 175 ml of water. And what is pictured in the bottom is the non-dissolved Rock grit
reviews.Title: So much rock grit

reviews.Author: Hillary Switzer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on August 7, 2024
reviews.Text: Just received my order and noticed the delivery package had an opening in the side. Didn’t really think too much about it, but then, upon inspection of the product, the screw off top was partly unscrewed and therefore the seal was broken 🤯 Don’t want to sound like a germ a’ phobic, but now I’m having second thought about what might have been placed on the package 😳
reviews.Title: Package was not sealed … unsure if it is safe to use or ask for a replacement or money back

reviews.Author: Jane in Iowa
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on April 15, 2026
reviews.Text: This salt will not disolve! When you cook with it, it leaves a definate grit i the food.
reviews.Title: Gritty

reviews.Author: Cherrie McCartney
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 3, 2026
reviews.Text: Found out after I ordered this salt, it has high levels of lead and arsenic in it. It will go straight in the trash.
reviews.Title: So disappointed

reviews.Author: P
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on June 30, 2023
reviews.Text: Why buy this product when there’s free sand at the beach. I thought i was buying salt but when i finished cooking my meal prep for the week i ended up with EVERYTHING i made was gritty like i dipped it in sand….I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT (plus i could not return so i wasted food and money)
reviews.Title: SAND

reviews.Author: Amazon Customer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on November 12, 2024
reviews.Text: I received the product in the mail yesterday and noticed that it wasn’t pure white…. But didn’t think it was a problem until I had it on my vegetables…. I had grit I was chewing. I couldn’t finish eating my dinner. Then I just read the reviews with 1 star and many said similar….. realized I wasn’t crazy.
reviews.Title: Chewing sand

reviews.Author: Amazon Customer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 28, 2019
reviews.Text: I really don't understand how this can get such high reviews. You'll find your food is crunchy after seasoning with this, and it's tooth-grinding crunch: very unpleasant. To prove this to yourself, put a teaspoon in your aeropress (with a filter), add boiling water and stir so the salt dissolves, and press out the saltwater. You'll find left on your filter is a dirty red ring (presumably from mud and iron), and sand.
reviews.Title: Sandy, dirty salt. Unfit for cooking.

reviews.Author: Maria Sinigur
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on August 3, 2024
reviews.Text: I would give it zero stars if I could, was looking forward to using this salt, but every single time I used it, I felt like I was eating sand. So I took some salt and dissolved it in hot water and there was indeed sand in it. So disappointed
reviews.Title: Gritty

reviews.Author: Steven B.
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 6, 2026
reviews.Text: Even though it's labeled "fine", it chews like adding sand to your food. Too many crunchy rocks for me.
reviews.Title: Salt?  Should say fine crunchy rocks.

reviews.Author: BrazucaMama
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on June 29, 2023
reviews.Text: This will leave your food tasting like you’ve put sand in it! Just look at the picture. You try to dissolve it in water and it shows the pink sand. It’s awful! Don’t waste you money like I did. Threw it in the trash, since my return window finished before I started using it.
reviews.Title: NOT Real salt

reviews.Author: Ashley K
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on November 1, 2025
reviews.Text: I was excited for this product as I saw it recommended by someone else. Unfortunately this salt or the container we received is gritty / Sandy making the dishes we'd made using this salt inedible.
reviews.Title: Gritty / sandy

reviews.Author: Amazon Customer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 17, 2025
reviews.Text: I was disappointed in this . I have been buying for a number of years. I was paying 9.99 for 26 oz and now you are charging 9.99 for 16 oz. It is 10 oz smaller. I will look for the product some other place.
reviews.Title: Check the weigh of the products.  They look the same, but they are not.  Very disappointed

reviews.Author: Tammy Chicko
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on May 25, 2024
reviews.Text: Bought this before reading the reviews which I never do, but it's salt right? Nope, it's a bag of sand. I put some in a clear bowl with water and most of it didn't dissolve. Pink sand and grit settled to the bottom. Glad I tried that before running an expensive food dish. DON'T BUY
reviews.Title: It's literally a bag of sand

reviews.Author: Patrick
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 29, 2026
reviews.Text: Lots of sand in this. Ended up throwing away.
reviews.Title: Sand!

reviews.Author: Chris
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 4, 2026
reviews.Text: I gave this one star so there’d be more for me. This salt is awesome.
reviews.Title: This salt is delicious

reviews.Author: Matto Borke
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 3, 2026
reviews.Text: High levels of lead and arsenic. High, but significant?? Do your own research. My batch I am tossing out.
reviews.Title: Check for lead and arsenic

reviews.Author: Katie
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 24, 2026
reviews.Text: This product gives a sand texture to foods (a literal crunch).
reviews.Title: Adds an additional crunch

reviews.Author: RCM
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 23, 2026
reviews.Text: Sandy af, cmon son who gonna be like “that’s how you know it’s good!” 🤦‍♂️
reviews.Title: Super Duper Sandy

reviews.Author: Jodi Pierce
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on May 15, 2024
reviews.Text: I am doing the carnivore diet and this salt was recommended because it is supposed to be better for you. It absolutely feels like eating sand! I’ve had see sea salt and kosher salt plenty of times and this is absolutely nothing like it. If you like eating sand you’ll like this!
reviews.Title: Very disappointed!

reviews.Author: JLW
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on April 9, 2024
reviews.Text: The salt is gritty and disgusting! I used it in my sourdough bread and it is ruined! The bread is gritty when you try to eat it. Not sure what the hype is about this salt. The bag is going in the trash since they won't take returns for their faulty product!
reviews.Title: Horrible

reviews.Author: Linda M.
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on February 11, 2020
reviews.Text: I wish I had read the negative reviews before purchasing a pound of this. I wanted sea salt, and with the amount of five star reviews, I figured it was a safe buy. Grains of sand can be seen in the bag and felt in my mouth. Very unpleasant. So I tested it with a full tsp. in a clear bowl. Then added in boiling water. The darker grains did not dissolve. Might be able to tolerate as a mouth rinse. Not a good purchase or return policy.
reviews.Title: Non returnable sand!

reviews.Author: Tammy Hudson
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 29, 2024
reviews.Text: When I opened the box there was loose salt all over. There was a slit in the middle of the bag. I won’t use it because I don’t trust it has not been tampered with. I want to exchange it but it is not eligible. I should not have to pay for unsafe salt.
reviews.Title: Buyer beware. Not returnable Arrived with a slit in the bag.

reviews.Author: Kristin
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on April 19, 2025
reviews.Text: My fault for not looking more closely at the size of this bag, but it’s definitely not worth the money for such a small bag. Hasn’t been opened but not eligible for return. Don’t make the same mistake I did.
reviews.Title: Not worth the price

reviews.Author: golfergirl
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 25, 2025
reviews.Text: I purchased this salt because I was told that it would help inflammation. I was very anxious to try it, but I could not get past the chemical taste. I only used a quarter of a teaspoon in 17 ounces of water.
reviews.Title: The Taste is Awful

reviews.Author: Kim Muchmore
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on November 24, 2025
reviews.Text: Ordered this based on a Dr who uses it but then heard it tested high for lead so will be returning it.
reviews.Title: Scared to use it 😔

reviews.Author: Sproduct
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on September 5, 2025
reviews.Text: Do not buy this!! It’s awful tasting and full of heavy metals!! I can’t return it. Complete waste of $10 for 16oz of salt. Don’t support a product that’s unsafe especially if canning.

reviews.Author: Margaret
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on November 3, 2025

reviews.Author: Cesur Dagli

reviews.Text: I was assuming that I bought a package of salt. But it's full of tiny stone or sand.. I felt like I was eating sand soup every bite. please consider these reviews. People's health is at risk. I don't want to have a kidney disease.. never buy again..!
